blocks.text: HANGS Construction Services LLC and HANGS Property Holdings LLC. Invented policy book for a software demonstration.
Record any single item that costs $5,000 or more and will be used for more than one year as a fixed asset. The threshold applies to each item, not to the invoice total.
CAP-2 Full Cost of an Asset

A fixed asset’s recorded cost includes everything needed to buy it and get it ready for use: the price, freight and delivery, setup, installation, testing and sales tax. Book these charges to the asset, not to expense. This follows the historical cost principle under GAAP.
Project managers approve up to $10,000 per invoice, on their own jobs only. The Controller approves up to $50,000. Anything above $50,000 needs the CFO.
An approval covers the invoice total, including tax and freight. Approving the subtotal does not approve the invoice.
BOOK-1 Enter What the Invoice Says
Enter the invoice total exactly as printed. Do not round, and do not re-key amounts from memory.
Before posting, match the vendor, invoice number and amount against bills already entered. The same invoice number with different spacing or punctuation is the same invoice.
Work finished by the last day of the month belongs in that month. If the bill is not entered by close, accrue it and reverse the accrual when the bill is entered.
ENT-1 Book to the Billed Entity
Book each invoice in the HANGS entity named on it. If another HANGS entity pays it, record that through the Due To and Due From accounts, not as an expense of the paying entity.
Construction costs go to the job and cost code the work was for. Use the job reference printed on the invoice.
Every bill entered for payment needs the vendor’s invoice on file before it is paid.
Do not pay a new vendor until a signed Form W-9 is on file.
Used only when a vendor has no past bills. Words on the invoice point to a cost code. (Page 16)

policies.title: Book to the Billed Entity
policies.text: Book each invoice in the HANGS entity named on it. If another HANGS entity pays it, record that through the Due To and Due From accounts, not as an expense of the paying entity.

policies.title: Charge the Right Job
policies.text: Construction costs go to the job and cost code the work was for. Use the job reference printed on the invoice.

policies.title: No Invoice, No Payment
policies.text: Every bill entered for payment needs the vendor’s invoice on file before it is paid.

policies.title: New Vendors
policies.text: Do not pay a new vendor until a signed Form W-9 is on file.

checks.title: KRE-2207 CAP-2
